market_outlook.short_term: Volatile but constructive. Yen strength and Japan intervention create FX headwinds for USD assets. Oil and copper supported by geopolitics. CPI data this week is critical—rate hike bets could pressure equities and crypto. Apple launch and Jio IPO provide catalysts. Summer lull ending means elevated volatility into Q4.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle remains primary equity driver through 2027. China stimulus supports global growth but export shock caps upside. Fiscal risk in US (4.8% yields) and Japan (GPIF review) creates structural headwinds for long-duration assets. Commodities structurally tight. Healthcare AI (Insilico) and precision medicine offer 5-year compounders.
